Runs

Every five-fold run. Gold (58 studies) is the arbiter, and differences below about 0.02 are noise there. Report (4,349 studies) is the steadier signal for choosing. Δ columns compare each run with the reference on the same studies (paired bootstrap, 90% interval).

What limits each label

The labeller's agreement with gold is roughly the ceiling for anything trained on its labels. A big gap between it and the model means the image features are the limit; a low labeller score means the labels are.

Report AUC by knee side. Bold labels sit on one side of the knee, so they land on opposite image sides for left and right knees.
